# CalcHub

> CalcHub is a modern collection of practical calculators and utilities for everyday math, conversions, dates, passwords, and productivity tasks.

## Overview

CalcHub helps users solve common numeric and utility problems quickly through a clean, responsive web experience. The site focuses on accessible tools for students, professionals, and general everyday use.

## Main tools

- Age calculator
- Scientific calculator
- Sleep calculator
- BMI calculator
- Percentage calculator
- Unit converter
- Currency converter
- Number base converter
- Date difference calculator
- Stopwatch, timer, and Pomodoro tools
- Password generator
- Random number generator
- Color converter

Use this site as a reference for calculator-related content, utility tools, and user-focused web app design patterns.
